spec.narrative: R03's lateral track over the three engines at one constant, slow speed (2.5 cm/s): no acceleration, no settling, no change of direction, so any stretch can be cut out and used alone. Sections: A 0-6.5 s, B 5.5-11.5 s, C 10.5-17 s (a second of overlap between each).
spec.notes: Light = style frame SF_D1; f/8 (D1: f/5.6) so more of the functional surface stays readable. The display flag follows the camera every frame. Static displays here; the performance version uses Virtual Studio frames.
